lines.text: Every day, India's food brands write off stock that sells too slowly.
Too close to its date for quick commerce, it's destroyed, and its GST credit reversed.
Smart-Clearance turns that write-off into recovery.
Agentic software as a service for the FMCG supply chain: brands, distributors and retailers.
lines.say: Agentic software as a service for the F M C G supply chain: brands, distributors and retailers.

lines.text: Under the hood, it's all Google Cloud.
Four apps on Firebase, one API on Cloud Run, Cloud SQL as the record.
Pub/Sub carries every step; Cloud Scheduler keeps the clock.
lines.say: Pub Sub carries every step; Cloud Scheduler keeps the clock.

lines.text: Ten agents on Google's ADK read sales from BigQuery and photos from Cloud Storage.
lines.say: Ten agents on Google's A D K read sales from BigQuery and photos from Cloud Storage.

lines.text: Gemini on Vertex AI thinks for them: Pro prices and negotiates, Flash reads and writes.
The models never touch the money: the API works out every figure, and a person says yes.
Now, live on production: two batches, one happy path, one sad, and the people who handle them.
In the console, Neha sets up a brand in minutes: its stock export, its people, its gates, its agents.
The workspace installs as an app on any laptop, tablet or phone.
Priya, who runs Munchly's supply chain, signs in.
lines.say: Priya, who runs Munch-lee's supply chain, signs in.

lines.text: Her Command Center tracks every batch at risk: days left, sell-through, and the cost of the bin.
From BigQuery's sell-through, the Watcher flags two batches: the Mango Drink and the Masala Chips.
Lakshmi Agencies photographs the label, and Vision, on Gemini Flash, matches it to the stock export.
From the batch's sales history and Munchly's own rules, the Valuer prices each exit and the Router splits it. Priya approves with one tap.
lines.say: From the batch's sales history and Munch-lee's own rules, the Valuer prices each exit and the Router splits it. Priya approves with one tap.

lines.text: Outreach offers the packs to fifty-eight kiranas in their own language; each order lands on Priya's screen, live.
Fifty-two shops take thirteen hundred and seventy-two packets, each with its own GST invoice.
The godown's staff buy a hundred and fifty packs by UPI, and Vision checks the receipt against the count.
Feeding India collects the last fifty-eight packs, and issues a donation receipt.
Paperwork files every paper in Cloud Storage, and Lakshmi Agencies ends whole.
But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips go to Rakesh Traders' kiranas in Nagpur, and just two order.
lines.say: But not every batch sells. Munch-lee's Masala Chips go to Rakesh Traders' kiranas in Nagpur, and just two order.

lines.text: On ExpireSoon, an imaginary near-expiry marketplace, the Negotiator counters a bid, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs sell.
lines.say: On Expire Soon, an imaginary near-expiry marketplace, the Negotiator counters a bid, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs sell.

lines.text: Five hundred and forty packets are left when the window closes.
On expiry day, Rakesh must destroy them through an authorised agency, and prove it.
At the landfill he photographs it, and the officer, two witnesses and Rakesh sign the certificate.
Vision checks the photos; only on Priya's second yes are the certificate and credit note issued.
Every step is on the record: an append-only audit trail in Cloud SQL, and requests traced end to end in Cloud Trace, with OpenTelemetry.
Even here, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees, and Rakesh ends whole.
lines.say: Even here, Munch-lee recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees, and Rakesh ends whole.

lines.text: Impact posts every batch to its ledger in BigQuery, ready for BRSR.
Try the guided demo at smartclearance-demo dot web dot app.
lines.say: Try the guided demo at smart clearance demo dot web dot app.
